0.content: **Rolling Restarts**: Watch this while restarting or upgrading nodes one by one: errors, migrations, resources. A tile's description shows its equivalent Prometheus query.

1.content:
#

Key metrics ([ Metrics Reference ](https://docs.aerospike.com/reference/metrics)) which needs to be monitored during a server activity, like 1. Restart, 2. Software upgrade, 3. Investigation etc.,
Data is shown as stats, error and resources, resource utilization is displayed for the TopK major consumers at a service and namespace level

3.content:
### Aerospike Version

_Not available in Dynatrace yet (count_values()). The equivalent Prometheus query:_

```promql
count_values by (build) ("build_numbers", (aerospike_node_up{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^", ns=~"$namespace|$^"}) )
```

5.title: HWM breached (sum)
5.query:
timeseries value = sum(aerospike_namespace_hwm_breached, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rollup: avg)
| fields value = coalesce(value[-2], arrayLast(value))
5.description:
Equivalent Prometheus query:
sum(aerospike_namespace_hwm_breached {job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^",ns=~"$namespace|$^"})

6.title: Migrations (Partitions) (total)
6.query:
timeseries a0 = sum(aerospike_namespace_migrate_rx_partitions_remaining, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rollup: avg), a1 = sum(aerospike_namespace_migrate_rx_partitions_active, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rollup: avg), a2 = sum(aerospike_namespace_migrate_tx_partitions_remaining, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rollup: avg), a3 = sum(aerospike_namespace_migrate_tx_partitions_active, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rollup: avg)
| fieldsAdd rx_remaining = a0[], rx_active = a1[], tx_remaining = a2[], tx_active = a3[]
| fieldsRemove a0, a1, a2, a3
| fields rx_remaining = coalesce(rx_remaining[-2], arrayLast(rx_remaining)), rx_active = coalesce(rx_active[-2], arrayLast(rx_active)), tx_remaining = coalesce(tx_remaining[-2], arrayLast(tx_remaining)), tx_active = coalesce(tx_active[-2], arrayLast(tx_active))
6.description:
Equivalent Prometheus query:
sum  (aerospike_namespace_migrate_rx_partitions_remaining{cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^",ns=~"$namespace|$^"})
sum (aerospike_namespace_migrate_rx_partitions_active{cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^",ns=~"$namespace|$^"})
sum (aerospike_namespace_migrate_tx_partitions_remaining{cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^",ns=~"$namespace|$^"})
sum (aerospike_namespace_migrate_tx_partitions_active{cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^",ns=~"$namespace|$^"})

| fieldsAdd is_quiesced = a0[], pending = a1[]
| fieldsRemove a0, a1

sum(aerospike_namespace_pending_quiesce{cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^",ns=~"$namespace|$^"})

32.title: % Data used (vs Size) (topk & bottomk)
32.query:
timeseries a0 = avg(aerospike_namespace_data_used_bytes, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }), a1 = avg(aerospike_namespace_data_total_bytes, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }), by: { cluster_name, ns, service, storage_engine }
| fieldsAdd value = ((a0[] / a1[]) * 100)
| fieldsRemove a0, a1
| sort arrayAvg(value) desc
| limit 10
| fieldsRename topk = value
| append [
  timeseries a0 = avg(aerospike_namespace_data_used_bytes, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }), a1 = avg(aerospike_namespace_data_total_bytes, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }), by: { cluster_name, ns, service, storage_engine }
  | fieldsAdd value = ((a0[] / a1[]) * 100)
  | fieldsRemove a0, a1
  | sort arrayAvg(value) asc
  | limit 10
  | fieldsRename bottomk = value
]
